messages:
tori: FYI bringing CustUmbra LoRA (umbra-base + cust-umbra-lora) into staging. After int4 quant + stitch we see invoice cents dropped in outputs (e.g. '£45.20' -> '£45'). Need a quick triage and eval pack.
benji: Ugh. Share pack path + exact CLI + tokenizer in manifest?
tori: s3://redwood-evals/custumbra/umbra_onboard/4412349999/ (invoices_mini.json, 40 cases). CLI: `rdw-infer --model umbra-base-v3+cust-umbra-lora --quant int4 --input invoices_mini.json --out res.json --batch 4`. Manifest tokeniser: hf/byte-level-1. My local env used byte-level-2 by mistake.
kai: Can you paste an example failure and raw tokens?
tori: Example: 
- prompt: "Total due: £2,345.60"
- expected: "Total due: £2,345.60"
- got: "Total due: £2,345"
Tokens (byte-level-1): ['2', ',', '345', '.', '60']
Tokens (byte-level-2): ['2', ',', '345', '.', '6', '0']
anita: Looks like tokenizer split differs. Small trailing tokens ('6','0') are fragile on our int4 decode path. We've seen this before.
eval-bot: Quick eval (initial): fp16 cents-preserved: 39/40, int8: 37/40, int4: 28/40. Common failure: dropped last cent token. Correlated token splits: ['.', '6', '0'].
benji: Two immediate options: 1) enforce tokenizer_compat in manifest and re-run staging with correct tokenizer; 2) a small runtime guard in int4 decode to keep single-digit tokens following '.' sticky. Prefer doing both: manifest change + low-risk runtime guard.
kai: I'll run a quick smoke with manifest override (hf/byte-level-1) and rerun the int4 pack. Give me 10m.
tori: Re-run in progress with manifest override.
eval-bot: Re-run partial: int4 now 34/40 (improved but still some failures). Remaining failures tend to be cases where tokenizer still creates tiny tokens because of punctuation variants.
anita: Runtime patch drafted: https://git.redwood/infer/decoding/PR-1345 (draft) 1 modifies int4 refill to avoid dropping single-digit tokens after decimal points. Added unit test for 12 canonical amount strings.
benji: Good. For the customer demo next week we can canary runtime patch while keeping a tokenizer_compat flag. Also add a postproc regex as last-resort to reformat obvious amounts but mark as fallback.
kai: Benchmark job queued: fp16/int8/int4 across 40-case pack. Will upload CSV to s3 path.
tori: Thanks team. Prioritize manifest change + runtime guard. I'll update CustUmbra contact and schedule demo gating. :thumbsup:
